definitions.core_principle: Educational merit does not decide job timing; the dasa running in the job-seeking years does. A 'good' dasa (even Jupiter) can block job satisfaction if its lord is tied up with own/exalted planets. Predict the success window so the native can set expectations - frustration comes from expectation, not from the delay itself.
definitions.own_exalted_lock: Dasa lord conjoined with, aspected by, or in the star of own/exalted planets -> 'over-strength'; job keeps getting disturbed / unsatisfying in that dasa.
definitions.no_pure_chart: No chart is fully yogic or fully afflicted; every chart gets a success period.
definitions.dasa_gate: All results by dasa/bhukti; a dasa arriving very late (e.g. after ~70) can be ignored for career.

rules.name: Own/exalted lock on the dasa lord
rules.condition: dasa lord sits with an own/exalted planet AND/OR in the star of an own/exalted planet AND/OR is aspected by another own/exalted planet
rules.result: Job not settled / below expectations through this dasa: may have to relocate, accept a lower-than-qualified role (~1/3-1/2 of expected pay); own business not feasible (no capital, won't succeed).
rules.second_half: Second half of the dasa gives breathing space - roughly 40-50% of what the next good dasa will pay.

rules.name: Dusthana planet not 'hidden'
rules.rule: A planet in 6/8/12 is not hidden if that house's lord is own/exalted (e.g. Jupiter in 8th with own-sign Mars; Sun in 6th with exalted Mercury -> education completed, children fine).

rules.name: Rahu + Venus in 7th in study years
Badhaka 11th lord own sign, retrograde
rules.example: Mesha lagna: Saturn (lord_10 + lord_11, badhaka) own sign in 11th, retrograde, mutual aspect with own-sign Mars; lord_2 Venus own sign in 7th
rules.result: Saturn dasa = big yoga in employment (top roles, 2x earlier earnings). Not own business because the 10th lord is retrograde.
rules.if_direct: Badhaka nature would act negatively (but own-sign Saturn-Mars mutual aspect still boosts).

rules.name: Dhana yoga: lord_2 and lord_11 own sign
Job -> own business / investments
rules.condition: Mercury dasa after a successful dasa, Mercury exalted and in a star of a planet in an exalted planet's sign
rules.result: Moves from job to own venture with maturity and savings; income from investments (mutual funds, shares) or trading.

rules.name: Success-window output
rules.method: Walk the dasa timeline; mark each dasa as 'unsettled', 'breathing space', 'peak', 'transition to business/investment', 'late (ignore)'. Report the start age of the first peak dasa.

engine_output_suggestion.career_window: Show: current dasa status, when it eases (second half), next peak dasa with start date and job vs business suitability.

open_questions_for_implementation: Weight of each lock component (conjunction vs star vs aspect)
Define 'first half / second half' as by bhukti order or by calendar midpoint
